home.title: Source from verified Chinese manufacturers, with confidence.
home.subtitle: CargoScope connects Kenyan wholesale buyers with vetted factories — transparent landed costs, in-app translation, and trust built in at every step.

pillars.verifiedBody: Every manufacturer is document-checked and tier-rated before they can list, so you know who you are buying from.
pillars.landedBody: See the real price in KES — product, freight, duty, and fees — before you commit, with no surprises at the port.
pillars.translateBody: Message factories in English or Swahili and we translate to Mandarin instantly, so nothing gets lost.

howItWorks.title: How CargoScope works
howItWorks.subtitle: A trust-first path from verified Chinese factories to your warehouse in Kenya.
howItWorks.step1Body: Every manufacturer is document-checked and tier-rated. Look for the verification badge before you buy.
howItWorks.step2Body: Get an all-in estimate in Kenyan shillings — product, freight, duty, and VAT — before you commit.
howItWorks.step3Body: Message factories in English or Swahili; we translate to Mandarin instantly so nothing is lost.
howItWorks.step4Body: Post an RFQ, compare quotes, and order knowing exactly who you are dealing with.
howItWorks.supplierStep1Body: Submit your business licence and documents to earn a trust badge buyers recognise.
howItWorks.supplierStep2Body: Add products with MOQ, tiered pricing, photos, and specifications.
howItWorks.supplierStep3Body: Respond to inquiries and RFQs from serious wholesale buyers.
